files.content:
name: Update profile card

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 6 * * *"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: update-profile-card
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "24"

      - name: Refresh profile card
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/update-profile-card.mjs
